message.content: {"question":"To calculate the orbit of a planet around the Sun, in addition to the mass of the planet and the Sun, it is necessary and sufficient to know: (a) the radius of the planet and of the Sun (b) the total angular momentum of the system (c) the total energy and the total angular momentum of the system (d) the total energy of the system","options":{"A":"the radius of the planet and of the Sun","B":"the total angular momentum of the system","C":"the total energy and the total angular momentum of the system","D":"the total energy of the system"},"correct":"C"}
